answer: Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 47 epochs of grading, and every nebula settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 47 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
